reason: I'd maybe throw the free 40 at our old Telegram history out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay. If someone on site is padding a nota or sending it twice, that's a people problem I solve with a call and a site visit, not a spreadsheet.
objection: A bot can read a handwritten nota, but it can't tell me whether the 40 bags of cement were actually delivered or whether the shop wrote the price my foreman asked for. A neat Google Sheet of dodgy receipts is still dodgy.
would_change_my_mind: If the free archive upload actually found a real duplicate or a total that doesn't add up in our old chats, money I'd already lost without noticing.
